svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Hooks in the React tree
svg.desc: Adds the Hooks proposal (useState, useEffect, useContext, and friends) behind enableHooks. Public APIs land in react, the hook list lives on a fiber, the server renderer gets a matching dispatcher, and a new eslint-plugin-react-hooks package teaches the Rules of Hooks. Class components stay the default path.
